entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-881-92B.

Certainly. Let me pull that up for you... VF-881-92B. I see the VeloFit Mountain Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I'm processing this correctly, could you tell me a bit about the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
They don't fit right. I took them on one ride and they gave me horrible blisters. The cleats also feel completely wrong no matter how I adjust them. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting the right fit is everything. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. I see the delivery date was 19 days ago.
Yes. So can I return them or not?
Yes, absolutely. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that window. I have just approved the return authorization.

I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to you. Simply box up the shoes, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any UPS location. And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee and added a $20 credit to your account for the trouble. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will process your full refund.
Okay, a credit is fine. That works. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
